author: thegoodbyecompany
caption: Okay throw away your shaving cream because I am not going back. 😂 I started using castor oil instead of shaving gel a few weeks ago just to see what would happen, and the difference in my skin afterward was honestly embarrassing. Like, why did nobody tell me about this sooner? The castor oil creates this really rich, smooth glide that lets the razor move without any drag or friction. So you get a closer shave without that irritation and razor burn that shows up a few hours later. You know that bumpy, itchy feeling you just accept as part of shaving? Gone. And then after you rinse, your skin is already moisturized. You do not need to pile lotion on afterward because the castor oil has already sealed everything in. My legs felt genuinely soft for days, not just the first few hours like regular shaving cream. The ricinoleic acid reduces the inflammation that causes razor burn and ingrown hairs at the source, so your skin actually recovers instead of just reacting. It is doing two jobs at once and doing both of them better than the products I was buying specifically for each one. Cold-pressed, USDA organic, nothing synthetic going on your skin during one of the most sensitive things you do to it. 🌿 One bottle. Replaces two products.
